Strongest: I think the variety in the activites was better than just making the course about writing. Sure, the main tasks were about writing but if it were just about writing, it would be less effective, creative and more boring. 

Weakest: I believe that instead of writing about a reaally general and irrelavant (to our departments) topics, trying to write with the languages of our departments would make the course more interesting and helpful for future usage of English. For example, we can learn how to write an academic report or how to make a scientific conclusion or how to express our thoughts more academically. I believe it might be hard to organize a topic that would appeal to all departments at the same time but maybe the topics that helps us think about our own real life would be more interesting and hepful. For example, intead of writing about the effects of civilization from hunter-gatherers until today, we could think about loneliness, university life, childhood, adultship or economy. I am not a historian and researching this topic (I believe) would not help me. However, everyone in this course have a university life or had a childhood or have to learn at least a little about economy. In short, the topics could be way more interesting.
The negative aspect of the course, independent of the instructor, is that there are too many unnecessary class hours and the permitted absence limit is too low.
